gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-esteban: Esteban is a classic serif with an oversized lowercase and thin strokes barely lighter than its stems. And Stentiga does its best work spaced far apart, while Esteban does its best work holding text together.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-faustina: Authoritative from the first line, Faustina has bowls that thin gently and an open-jawed c, sitting under luxurious Stentiga. Give Stentiga plenty of size and let Faustina stay modest.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-halant: Sturdy and tall in the lowercase, with a faint thick-thin shift and outward-pointing terminals, this serif has real authority. Halant's crayon-on-rough-paper rhythm is what sets it apart from the laser-cut precision of Stentiga.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-hedvig-letters-se: Hedvig Letters Serif is a serif with sturdy lowercase, open-ended curves and middling contrast. And in running text it should move along easily, with Stentiga keeping the heading spread out.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-lisu-bosa: Lisu Bosa, a classic serif, reads sturdy and editorial, with counters spilling into the space around each letter. Under Stentiga, longer text should flow with a lightly springy feel.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-marcellus-sc: Spread out and stately, Stentiga leads while Marcellus SC, a classic serif, brings gentle modulation and pulled-back terminals. Marcellus SC should read steadily across a full page, dignified without being stiff.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-montagu-slab: Comfortable on screen, with a sizable x-height and slender turns, this classic serif sits beneath Stentiga. Montagu Slab should carry running text smoothly, crossbars a touch thinner than its stems.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-serif-hentai: Wide tracking gives Stentiga its spread-out, luxurious look, with every stroke seeming to be cut from wire. Noto Serif Hentaigana tempers that with moderate stroke contrast and near-capital small letters.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-ovo: Ovo, a text serif, has a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and descenders, and thins only slightly lighter than thicks. Under Stentiga, it should read smoothly, with spacious gaps at curve ends.
gen-dafont-true-north-gf-domine: Domine is a text serif, dignified and compact above its tall lowercase. Its best quality is the breathing room inside each curve, a soft counterweight to the stocky, low-contrast heading of True North.
